scope: All original log rows and distinct eligible signatures; no packet counts inferred from log rows.

timestamp_contract.csv: Naive calendar strings, serialized fractional decimal seconds; widths1/2/3 pad on the right. Millisecond serialization does not prove millisecond accuracy or truncation vs rounding.
timestamp_contract.xlsx: 1900/1904 system retained; original numeric serial and exact decimal conversion preserved. Rounded microsecond integer only a join convenience; extra Excel decimals do not prove source-clock accuracy.
timestamp_contract.matched_event_time: ts_complete_us, based on epoch of the latest contributing reassembled-segment timestamp; ts_first_us and all segment timestamps retained.
unknowns: Actual logger call position relative to send/write
Global timezone/offset and capture-vs-tool clock drift
